jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Artificialy is an AI company based in Switzerland, with offices in Lugano and Zurich. We design and deliver AI solutions that are impactful, transparent, and tailored to real-world industry needs.

Founded in 2020 by pioneers with over 40 years of combined experience in the field, our team brings together talented engineers, physicists, and mathematicians from across Europe. We are driven by curiosity, technical excellence, and a shared ambition to build AI systems that make a tangible difference.

We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to lead and contribute to the development and evolution of our software products. You will work closely with the AI engineering team, taking a hands-on role in building key features and continuously improving code quality and development practices.

About the Role

• Act as the technical reference for product development, contributing to the technical direction and evolution of the company’s software AI products.

• Develop and maintain core product components and features, collaborating with the team to deliver new functionalities and improve existing ones.

• Design and implement scalable and efficient technical solutions, integrating AI models, pipelines, and services into applications while working with AI experts in NLP, optimization, computer vision, etc., depending on the needs.

• Participate in code reviews and contribute to code quality, consistency, testing, CI/CD, and application monitoring practices.

• Work with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient and high-quality delivery.

• Participate in strategic technological decisions and help shape product and engineering roadmaps.

Qualifications and Skills

• 5+ years of full stack software development experience, including contributive architectural design.

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.

• Strong proficiency in backend technologies such as Java (Spring) and Python (FastAPI).

• Strong proficiency in modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular with TypeScript), including ecosystem tools and best practices.

• Solid experience with APIs, databases, containerized environments, and modern development practices (Git, CI/CD, cloud-native or microservices architectures).

• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design.

• Experience building RESTful APIs and working with modern HTTP-based architectures.

• Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Experience with Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

• Proficiency in Italian and English.

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of C++, Rust, or other programming languages.

• Experience with Kubernetes or similar deployment and automation tools.

• Understanding of microservices and distributed systems, as well as cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Microsoft Azure

We offer

• Full-time permanent contract

• Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

• Possibility to work from home (about 1 day/week)

• A stimulating scientific environment with an informal working atmosphere

• Mentorship and continuous learning

• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um eine effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung sicherzustellen.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an strategischen technologischen Entscheidungen und gestalten Sie Produkt- und Engineering-Roadmaps mit.

Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung vollständiger Stack-Software, einschließlich des beitragenden Architekturdesigns.

• Bachelor oder Master in Informatik oder Computer Engineering.

• Starke Kenntnisse in Backend-Technologien wie Java (Spring) und Python (FastAPI).

• Starke Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Frameworks (React, Vue oder Angular mit TypeScript), einschließlich Ökosystem-Tools und Best Practices.

• Solide Erfahrung mit APIs, Datenbanken, containerisierten Umgebungen und modernen Entwicklungspraktiken (Git-, CI/CD-, Cloud-native- oder Microservice-Architekturen).

• Starkes Verständnis von Datenstrukturen, Algorithmen und Systemdesign.

• Erleben Sie die Erstellung von RESTful APIs und die Arbeit mit modernen HTTP-basierten Architekturen.

• Kenntnisse in SQL- und NoSQL-Datenbanken.

• Erfahrung mit Docker, Git und modernen CI/CD-Pipelines.

• Kenntnisse in Italienisch und Englisch.

Nizza zu haben

• Kenntnisse in C++, Rust oder anderen Programmiersprachen.

• Erfahrung mit Kubernetes oder ähnlichen Bereitstellungs- und Automatisierungstools.

• Verständnis von Microservices und verteilten Systemen sowie Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, GCP oder Microsoft Azure

• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und Wachstumschancen

• Möglichkeit, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten (ca. 1 Tag / Woche)

• Une bonne compréhension des structures de données, des algorithmes et de la conception du système.

• Expérimentez la construction d'APIs REST et travaillez avec des architectures HTTP modernes.

• Connaissance des bases de données SQL et NoSQL.

• Expérience avec les pipelines Docker, Git et CI/CD modernes.

• Compétence en italien et en anglais.

Sympa d'avoir

• Connaissance de C++, Rust ou d'autres langages de programmation.

• Expérience avec Kubernetes ou des outils de déploiement et d'automatisation similaires.

• Compréhension des microservices et des systèmes distribués, ainsi que des plateformes cloud telles que AWS, GCP ou Microsoft Azure

Nous offrons

• Contrat permanent à temps plein

• Compensation concurrentielle et possibilités de croissance

• Possibilité de travailler à domicile (environ 1 jour/semaine)

• Un environnement scientifique stimulant avec une atmosphère de travail informelle

• Mentorat et apprentissage continu

jobs.title: AI Scientist - LLM Systems
jobs.description:
Artificialy is an AI company based in Switzerland, with offices in Lugano and Zurich. We design and deliver AI solutions that are impactful, transparent, and tailored to real-world industry needs.

Founded in 2020 by pioneers with over 40 years of combined experience in the field, our team brings together talented engineers, physicists, and mathematicians from across Europe. We are driven by curiosity, technical excellence, and a shared ambition to build AI systems that make a tangible difference.

We are looking for a AI Scientist, who will work with clients in the financial sector to design and develop LLM-based solutions from early experimentation through to evaluation and delivery. You will own solution design and evaluation methodology within a project team, across a varied project portfolio.

This position can be based in Lugano or Zurich. You must be willing to work onsite at least 80% of the time. Candidates must be based in Switzerland or willing to relocate to Switzerland.

About the Role

• Your responsibilities will span the full lifecycle of LLM-based initiatives, from early experimentation and solution design through evaluation, delivery, and continuous improvement.

• Projects may involve retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems, fine-tuning, LLM-based evaluation frameworks (benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, error analysis), or other applied generative-AI solutions across a varied project portfolio.

• You will own solution design and evaluation methodology within project teams, collaborating with software engineering, infrastructure, and domain experts to integrate solutions into enterprise ecosystems and present results to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Qualifications and Skills

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent.

• 5+ years of working experience as AI Scientist or in a similar role or PhD

• Hands-on experience building LLM-based systems (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, or similar).

• Experience designing evaluations for ML/LLM systems (benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, error analysis).

• Strong programming skills (Python, SQL) and familiarity with ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.).

• Strong communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proficiency in English.

Nice to Have

• Experience in finance or other regulated industries.

• Journal publications

• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).

We offer

• Full-time permanent contract

• Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

• A stimulating scientific environment with an informal working atmosphere

• Mentorship and continuous learning

jobs.description:
Artificialy is an AI company based in Switzerland, with offices in Lugano and Zurich. We design and deliver AI solutions that are impactful, transparent, and tailored to real-world industry needs.

Founded in 2020 by pioneers with over 40 years of combined experience in the field, our team brings together talented engineers, physicists, and mathematicians from across Europe. We are driven by curiosity, technical excellence, and a shared ambition to build AI systems that make a tangible difference.

📍 Working Location
The role can be based in Lugano or Zurich. You must be willing to work onsite at least 80% of the time.

About the Role

Ready to build the cloud infrastructure behind the next generation of AI?

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who will design and operate the cloud infrastructure behind our AI and software solutions. You will work closely with clients, project managers, software engineers, and AI teams, taking ownership of Azure environments from architecture and deployment to automation and operations.

What you’ll do:

• Contribute to the migration and modernization of applications and services to Azure, ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.

• Build and maintain cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability solutions, and deployment automation, supporting both enterprise applications and AI/ML workloads.

• Collaborate with machine learning engineers and infrastructure teams to enable production-ready AI solutions, including MLOps workflows and Azure AI services.

• Work directly with clients (both remotely and in-person), combining strong technical expertise with excellent interpersonal skills.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent.

• 5+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or related fields.

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in production environments.

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• Experience designing and operating Azure landing zones, governance, and access models for production environments.

• Knowledge of Azure networking, identity, security, governance, and monitoring services.

• Experience with container technologies and orchestration tools (Docker, Azure Container Apps, or similar).

• Familiarity with Git-based workflows (GitLab, GitHub, Bitbucket).

• Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

• Proficiency in English.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Kubernetes

• Experience with observability tools, logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring (e.g. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry).

• Understanding of scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization.

• Experience supporting ML or AI workloads in production

• Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, or Azure OpenAI Service

• Background in manufacturing or engineering domains

• German language is a plus

We offer:

• Full-time permanent contract

• Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

• A stimulating scientific environment with an informal working atmosphere

• Mentorship and continuous learning and close relationship with cutting-edge research teams
